import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import math
print(veh)
"""
!!!! Set this path before running the demo!
"""
chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())
veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

# Initial vehicle location and orientation
initLoc = chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5)
initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

# Visualization type for vehicle parts (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

# Collision type for chassis (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
chassis_collision_type = veh.CollisionType_NONE

# Type of tire model (RIGID, TMEASY)
tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY

# Rigid terrain
# terrain_model = veh.RigidTerrain.BOX
terrainHeight = 0      # terrain height
terrainLength = 100.0  # size in X direction
terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Poon chassis tracked by the camera
trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(-5.0, 0.0, 1.8)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# --------------
# Create systems
# --------------

# Create the Sedan vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
vehicle = veh.BMW_E90()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)


vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface

vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('Sedan')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())


# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# ---------------
# Simulation loop
# ---------------

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)
    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh

# 1. Initialize the Chrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# 2. Create the terrain (rigid ground)
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(50, 0.2, 50, 1000, True, True)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -0.1, 0))
ground.SetBodyFixed(True)
system.Add(ground)

# Optional: Customize terrain appearance (textures, logos)
# Note: In PyChrono, visual customization can be done via visualization assets
# For simplicity, we'll add a basic texture
vis_terrain = chrono.ChVisualShape()
vis_terrain.SetTextureFilename("textures/terrain_texture.jpg")  # Placeholder path
ground.AddVisualShape(vis_terrain)

# 3. Create the vehicle
# Initialize the vehicle with default parameters
vehicle = veh.ChVehicleAssembly()

# Create the chassis
chassis = veh.ChBodyAuxRef()
chassis.SetBodyFixed(False)
chassis.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.5, 0))
system.Add(chassis)

# Initialize the vehicle with the chassis
my_vehicle = veh.ChVehicle()
my_vehicle.SetChassis(chassis)

# Add the vehicle to the assembly
vehicle.AddVehicle(my_vehicle)

# 4. Configure the vehicle visualization
# Enable visualization of the vehicle
my_vehicle.SetVisualizationType(veh.VEHICLE_VISUALIZATION_TYPE.VEHICLE_VISUALIZATION_TYPE_MESH)

# 5. Add tires with TMEASY model
# Define tire parameters
tire_radius = 0.33
tire_width = 0.2
tire_mass = 20
tire_inertia = chrono.ChVectorD(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

# Positions for four tires
tire_positions = [
    chrono.ChVectorD(1.2, 0, 1.0),   # Front right
    chrono.ChVectorD(-1.2, 0, 1.0),  # Front left
    chrono.ChVectorD(1.2, 0, -1.0),  # Rear right
    chrono.ChVectorD(-1.2, 0, -1.0)  # Rear left
]

# Create and add tires
for i, pos in enumerate(tire_positions):
    tire = veh.ChTMeasyTire()
    tire.SetRadius(tire_radius)
    tire.SetWidth(tire_width)
    tire.SetMass(tire_mass)
    tire.SetInertia(chrono.ChVectorD(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
    tire.Initialize(my_vehicle.GetChassisBody(), pos, chrono.QUNIT)
    tire.SetVisualizationType(veh.VEHICLE_TIRE_VISUALIZATION_TYPE.VEHICLE_TIRE_VISUALIZATION_TYPE_MESH)
    tire.SetUseMeshVisualization(True)
    tire.SetTextureFilename("textures/tire_texture.jpg")  # Placeholder path
    my_vehicle.AddTire(tire)

# 6. Set collision and contact parameters
# Enable collision detection for tires
for tire in my_vehicle.GetTires():
    tire.GetTireBody().SetCollide(True)

# 7. Add driver system for real-time control
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver()
driver.Initialize(system, my_vehicle.GetChassisBody())

# 8. Set up the Irrlicht visualization
# Create the Irrlicht application
application = veh.ChIrrApp(system, "BMW E90 Simulation", 800, 600, False, True)

# Add typical visualization assets
application.AddTypicalSky()
application.AddTypicalLights()
application.AddTypicalCamera(veh.ChVectorD(0, 2, -5))
application.SetChaseCamera(veh.ChVectorD(0, 1.5, -3),  # Camera position
                           veh.ChVectorD(0, 1, 0))     # Look-at point

# Enable logo overlay or custom textures if needed
# (Placeholder: actual implementation depends on available assets)

# 9. Simulation loop
application.AssetBindAll()
application.AssetUpdateAll()

# Simulation parameters
time_step = 0.005
application.SetTimestep(time_step)

# Run the simulation
while application.GetDevice().run():
    # Get user inputs for driver controls
    driver.Synchronize()
    driver.Advance(time_step)

    # Apply driver inputs to the vehicle
    my_vehicle.GetDrive().SetThrottle(driver.GetThrottle());
    my_vehicle.GetDrive().SetSteering(driver.GetSteering());
    my_vehicle.GetBrake().SetBraking(driver.GetBraking());

    # Advance the system
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

    # Update visualization
    application.BeginScene()
    application.DrawAll()
    application.EndScene()
```

```python
    steering_input2 = math.sin(2 * math.pi * 0.1 * time + math.pi/4)  # phase-shifted

    vehicle2.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs2, terrain1)
```
